1.name: Holy Strike
1.description: Strike down your target with holy energy, dealing 30% (L1) to 60% (L60) Weapon Ratio Damage plus 4 (L1) to 60 (L60) Holy Damage.

1.name: Lesser Resilience
1.description: Bestow lesser resilience upon your target, increasing their maximum Health by 10 (L1) to 20 (L8) for 1 hour.

1.name: Minor Heal
1.description: Slightly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 10 Health.

1.name: Rebuke
1.description: Strike your target with divine energy, dealing 3 (L1) to 5 (L4) Holy Damage.

4.name: Blessed Barrier
4.description: Shield your target with a blessed barrier, absorbing 25 damage received for 15 seconds.

4.name: Cure Disease
4.description: Cures your target, removing one Disease effect.

4.name: Cure Poison
4.description: Cure your target, removing one Poison effect.

4.name: Gate
4.description: Conjure a magical gate, returning you to your bind location. This spell has a slight chance to fail. This spell has no effect if you are encumbered.

4.name: Lesser Heal
4.description: Lightly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 25 Health.

4.name: Prayer of the Faithful I
4.description: Call upon your faith, increasing you Strength by 2, Mana Regeneration by 1, Secondary Mana Regeneration by 1, and Block by 25, granting you a chance to activate Fulfillment on melee attacks and the ability to see magical effects on targets for 2 hours. Fulfillment: Your prayers are answered, increasing your Attack Speed by 4% for 30 seconds. This effect stacks up to five time.

4.name: Rebuke II
4.description: Strike your target with divine energy, dealing 11 (L4) to 14 (L7) Holy Damage.

4.name: Smite the Dead I
4.description: Smite a target undead with holy light, dealing 14 Holy Damage.

4.name: Soulbind
4.description: Bind the soul of a target group member to their current location, causing them to respawn there upon death. This spell has no effect in certain areas.

4.name: Summon Hammer of the Righteous
4.description: Summon a Hammer of the Righteous, granting you a chance to activate Sanctified Hammer on melee hits while equipped. Additionally, Fulfillment grants you a chance to activate Sanctified hammer a second time. Sanctified Hammer: Purify your target, dealing 2 Holy Damage. This item does not persist after logging out.
